program:
PARAMS = {
    "L":     (0.18, 0.15, 0.5),
    "Iinv":  (55e-6, 25e-6, 66e-6),
    "Rf":    (120e3, 40e3, 400e3),
    "Cf":    (60e-15, 20e-15, 300e-15),
    "gtrim": (1.0, 0.96, 1.04),
    "ptrim": (1.0, 0.85, 1.15),
}

def _size_at_vgs(lut, dev, L, I, vgs_t):
    lo, hi = 2.0, 26.0
    op = None
    for _ in range(30):
        g = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        op = lut.size(dev, g, L, I, vds=0.9)
        if op.vgs > vgs_t:
            lo = g      # need weaker inversion -> larger gm/Id
        else:
            hi = g
    return op

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 0.2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    L = p["L"]
    I = min(p["Iinv"], 137e-6 / vdd - iref)

    mn = _size_at_vgs(lut, "n", L, I, 0.9)
    mp = _size_at_vgs(lut, "p", L, I, 0.9)
    # balance currents at vin = 0.9 with forward model
    In = lut.op("n", mn.W, L, 0.9, 0.9)["Id"]
    Ip = lut.op("p", mp.W, L, 0.9, 0.9)["Id"]
    Wn = mn.W * I / max(In, 1e-12)
    Wp = mp.W * I / max(Ip, 1e-12) * p["ptrim"]

    m_r = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)

    Rf = p["Rf"]
    g1t, g2t = 0.1571, 0.01797
    k1, k2 = g1t, g2t
    Gm = mn.gm + mp.gm
    gds = mn.gds + mp.gds
    A = 10.0
    for _ in range(8):
        Rp = Rf / (k1 + k2)
        gl = gds + 1.0 / (Rf + Rp)
        A = Gm / gl
        fix = 1.0 + (1.0 + k1 + k2) / A
        k1 = g1t * fix * p["gtrim"]
        k2 = g2t * fix * p["gtrim"]
    R1 = Rf / k1; R2 = Rf / k2
    Cf = p["Cf"]; C1 = k1 * Cf; C2 = k2 * Cf

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_r)
    n.M("MN", "vout", "vn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, L)
    n.M("MP", "vout", "vn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, L)
    n.C("CVCM", "vcm", "vss", 10e-15)
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "vn", R1); n.C("C1", "vin1", "vn", C1)
    n.R("R2", "vin2", "vn", R2); n.C("C2", "vin2", "vn", C2)
    n.R("RF", "vn", "vout", Rf); n.C("CF", "vn", "vout", Cf)

    a1 = -k1 / (1.0 + (1.0 + k1 + k2) / A)
    a2 = -k2 / (1.0 + (1.0 + k1 + k2) / A)
    cin = mn.cgg + mp.cgg
    beta_hf = Cf / (Cf + C1 + C2 + cin)
    cser = Cf * (C1 + C2 + cin) / (Cf + C1 + C2 + cin)
    cout = cl + cser + mn.cdd + mp.cdd
    bw = Gm / (2 * PI * cout) * beta_hf
    power = vdd * (iref + I)
    return n, {"a1": a1, "a2": a2, "bw": bw, "power": power,
               "vout_offset": 0.0, "A_ol_db": db(A), "Gm": Gm,
               "gmid_n": mn.gm_id, "gmid_p": mp.gm_id}
